name: HC20: No. active on ART with a clinical contact having a positive screen whose specimen was tested for bacteriological diagnosis
description: Counts unique patients who were active on ART, had a clinical contact during the reporting quarter, screened positive for TB, and had a specimen submitted for a bacteriological TB diagnostic test during the same reporting quarter.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

  "themeIndependent": true,

         AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
        OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
    )

    AND a.encounter_date >= :startDate
    AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    AND EXISTS (

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE
    (
        (a.encounter_date >= :startDate
         AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
        OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
    )

    AND a.encounter_date >= :startDate
    AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
        WHERE s.patient_id = a.patient_id
    )

    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
        WHERE r.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL
          AND r.art_start_date <= :endDate
    )
    AND a.tuberculosis_status like '%Suspect%'

    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_test_orders t
        WHERE t.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND t.date_activated >= :startDate
          AND t.date_activated < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
          AND t.test_name IN (
              'Gene Xpert',
              'TB LAM',
              'TB Microscopy'
          )
    );
